description: This file is an __init__.py module for the mod_pywebsocket third-party library, providing documentation and licensing info for the WebSocket extension for Apache HTTP Server, including setup, handler functions, subprotocol negotiation, data transfer, connection closing, threading, and extension processing.

methods.name: web_socket_do_extra_handshake
methods.description: Handles additional WebSocket handshake processing, including subprotocol negotiation and request rejection.

methods.name: web_socket_transfer_data
methods.description: Manages data transfer after handshake, including receiving and sending messages.

methods.name: web_socket_passive_closing_handshake
methods.description: Handles server response to incoming closing frames, returning close code and reason.
